items.name: agent.context
items.description: Assemble agent execution context (history, tools, user prefs).

items.description: Simple cache operations via Redis when available.

items.name: catalog.discover
items.description: Discover available MCP tools with metadata.

items.name: data.archive
items.description: Mark, restore, purge, or list archived data.

items.name: data.quality
items.description: Run data quality checks on graph nodes and relationships.

items.name: db.switch
items.description: Switch the active database/connection profile (dev/demo).

items.name: errors.report
items.description: Record and retrieve structured error reports.

items.name: graph.analytics
items.description: Run simple graph analytics tasks (e.g., degree counts).

items.name: graph.bulk
items.description: Bulk load/export utility for nodes and relationships.

items.name: graph.crud
items.description: Create/read/update/delete nodes or relationships.

items.name: graph.generate_cypher
items.description: Generate a safe Cypher query from a natural language goal.

items.name: graph.query
items.description: Execute ad-hoc Cypher query against Memgraph with optional parameters.

items.name: graph.schema
items.description: Discover labels, relationship types, and property keys.

items.name: graph.search
items.description: Semantic or property-based search over the graph.

items.name: graph.secure_query
items.description: Safely answer user prompts over Memgraph: NL→Cypher, validate (read-only + safety + permissions), execute if allowed, return results.

items.name: model.manage
items.description: List, load/unload models, and set defaults.

items.name: model.test
items.description: Run a short completion to validate model wiring.

items.name: output.format
items.description: Format a template with variables (safe minimal templating).

items.name: output.summarize
items.description: Summarize text using the default model with privacy guardrails.

items.name: privacy.consent
items.description: Record, check, or revoke a user's consent for data processing.

items.name: ratelimit.manage
items.description: Inspect or adjust rate limit keys.

items.name: security.audit
items.description: Record and retrieve audit events.

items.name: security.check
items.description: Run security checks on text or Cypher.

items.name: security.permissions
items.description: Resolve scopes for a role or principal.

items.name: session.manage
items.description: Create/read/update/delete session metadata.

items.name: system.backup
items.description: Trigger/inspect backups.

items.name: system.health
items.description: Return liveness and dependency checks.

items.name: system.metrics
items.description: Expose metrics snapshot (Prometheus/text or JSON).

items.name: system.status
items.description: Return service status summary.

items.name: tenancy.manage
items.description: Select or list tenants; manage allowlist (dev-mode).

items.name: user.profile
items.description: Get or update the current user's profile (non-sensitive demo data).

items.name: viz.render
items.description: Render helpers for graphs, tables, and sparklines (Mermaid/DOT/Markdown/sparkline).
